name: How long does a typical fence stability restoration project take?
description: Project duration depends on damage scale; minor repairs may take a day, while larger projects could take several days.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical fence stability restoration project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a fence stability restoration project depends on the scale of the damage and the complexity of the repairs. Minor restorations, like replacing one or two posts, might take a single day. Larger projects involving multiple sections or extensive reinforcement could extend to several days. Factors such as weather conditions and material availability can also affect the overall timeline.
